title: Ledger report
description: Who did the work on each item, as which role and on which model: spawns, starts, runs and usage samples from the one history (spec/history.schema.json). Each era's placeholders are counted in a corner, never shown as values. Replaces the per-session ledger files as its source (#48, V1). The page reads one file, a history's events.jsonl, and of each row only the fields below for its type ("*": every row); harness page --live --page ledger renders it, and its refresh button reads the file again through the Artifact files capability. Each item's Time and tokens section reads usage.jsonl beside the history (reads.onDemand: history.schema.json usage, which scripts/history/usage.mjs writes from the session ledgers) only when the viewer opens it, and of each row only the fields listed there.
